title: Ticket Booth
text: The turnstile clicks by itself. Two lights drift behind the glass.

title: The Carousel
text: The painted horses turn with no power, and something rides them.

title: Cotton Candy Stand
text: The vendor mascot still waves. Its head turns too far.

title: Photo Booth
text: The booth prints a photo from 1987: the staff team. Walt is in it, the same age as tonight.

title: Ring Toss Alley
text: The barker animatronic calls you over. Its prizes are teeth.

title: Ferris Wheel Base
text: A shape climbs down the frozen wheel, one car at a time.

title: Hall of Mirrors
text: A hundred of you. No Walt in any mirror.

title: Rolling Barrel Tunnel
text: The tunnel spins. Lights spin with it.

title: The Tilted Room
text: The floor leans. Something rolls toward you.

title: Laughing Lady Stage
text: The giant laughing doll starts to laugh. It does not stop.

title: Clown Alley
text: The barker's clowns waited backstage for you.

title: Puppet Theater
text: The puppets wear the staff uniforms from the photo.

title: Ghost Train
text: The cart moves on its own. The ride's ghosts are real now.

title: Tunnel of Boats
text: Black water. Something under the boat.

title: Haunted Manor Ride
text: The fake ghosts have been replaced.

title: Log Flume
text: The logs are full of rainwater and passengers.

title: Wax Museum
text: Wax figures of the 1987 staff. One spot is empty, labelled 'W. Hale, Mechanic'.

title: Maintenance Workshop
text: Walt's workshop. His radio here is melted. The one he carries still works.

title: The Exit Gate
text: Walt stops at the gate. 'I watched you all night. Every swing, every mistake. I know exactly how you fight.' His flashlight turns cold blue.
